priv.title: Privacy notice
priv.h.controller: Who is responsible for your data
priv.collect1: When you register for {event} we collect: your callsign, name, email address, country, optional phone number, the type of accommodation and the days or nights you choose, meal and extra-night choices, optional dietary requirements, optional T-shirt size, optional free-text comments, and the price calculated for your booking. The organizers may add a room number, an internal comment and your check-in status.
priv.collect2: We use this data *only* to register you, allocate rooms and places, plan catering, calculate your fees, contact you about your booking and the event, and check you in on site. We do not use it for marketing, we do not sell it, we do not profile you and we make no automated decisions about you.
priv.basis1: Registration, accommodation, catering and fees: taking steps at your request to enter into a contract and performing it (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
priv.basis2: Showing your callsign and first name on the public participant list: your consent, which is optional and given by ticking a box (Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time.
priv.basis3: Dietary requirements can reveal health or religious information. They are optional; by filling them in you give your explicit consent for catering use only (Art. 9(2)(a)).
priv.basis4: Basic security and error logs: our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure (Art. 6(1)(f)). These logs hold callsigns and booking references, not names or emails.
priv.who: Only the event organizers and volunteers who need it to run the event have access, through a password-protected admin area. If you share a room, your roommates and the room's primary booker see the names and callsigns needed to coordinate. The venue or hotel receives the names, stay dates and dietary information it needs for rooming and catering. Our hosting and email providers process data on our behalf. If you give consent, your callsign and first name appear on the public participant list; nothing else is published.
priv.keepExtra: Backups, if any, are erased or overwritten on the same schedule. Confirmation emails already sent to you stay in your own mailbox.
priv.retDate: We erase all personal data from the booking system no later than {date} ({n} days after the event ends on {end}).
priv.retNoDate: We erase all personal data from the booking system no later than {n} days after the event ends.
priv.retMatter: If an open matter related to the event (for example a payment dispute or a complaint) still needs the data, we keep only what that matter requires and erase it as soon as the matter is closed.
priv.rights1: You have the right to access your data, have it corrected, have it erased, restrict or object to its processing, receive it in a portable format, and withdraw consent at any time. {contact} You also have the right to complain to the data protection authority of your country.
priv.rightsContactMail: To use any of these rights write to {mail}.
priv.rightsContactNone: To use any of these rights contact the organizers.
priv.rights2: Providing the registration data is necessary to take part in the event. Without it we cannot register you.
priv.cookies: The public booking pages set no cookies and use no analytics, advertising or tracking tools, and load no fonts or scripts from other sites. Organizers who log in to the admin area receive one strictly necessary session cookie. Your web host or reverse proxy may keep technical access logs (for example IP addresses) for security; the booking application itself does not store them.
priv.transfers: Your data is stored on the organizer's own server or hosting provider. If a provider outside the EU/EEA is used, the organizer ensures an adequate safeguard such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
priv.short: {controller} collects this information only to register you for {event} and to organize the event (accommodation, catering, check-in and contacting you about your booking). It is not used for any other purpose, not sold, and not shared with anyone who does not need it to organize the event. {retention}

mail.shareRoomBody:
Anyone joining your room MUST use one of these options:

  1) Use "Join a booking" on the booking page and enter your
     booking reference: {ref}

  2) Or use this direct join link (pre-fills the reference):
     {url}

Roommates who do NOT use the join option will be registered
as separate guests and may be assigned a different room.
mail.shareCamperBody:
Anyone travelling in the same vehicle MUST use one of these options:

  1) Use "Join a booking" on the booking page and enter your
     booking reference: {ref}

  2) Or use this direct join link (pre-fills the reference):
     {url}

Co-travellers who do NOT use the join option will be registered
as separate camper spots.

mail.eraseBody:
This is the last message you will receive from us about your registration for {event} (booking {ref}).

All personal data we held about you in the booking system is being erased now: your name, callsign, email address, phone number, country, dietary and other registration details, and related log entries. We will not contact you again about this event.

Messages we sent earlier remain in your own mailbox, which we cannot reach.
